name: AK16A - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), Slim Desktop
highlights: Eight Parameters on a 24 mm Panel — CO2, TVOC, formaldehyde, three particulate fractions, temperature and humidity — the full indoor air picture in a body no thicker than a paperback, with a fold-out rear stand.

Particulates Split Three Ways — PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 reported separately by a laser module. A single lumped particulate number hides which fraction is actually elevated, and the fractions have different sources.
Every Value Carries Its Own Status Bar — Eight readings gridded on one screen, each with a colour band beneath it. Nothing needs checking against a reference table.
2000 mAh, Six Hours Cordless — Three-hour charge over USB-C. The fold-out stand angles the panel for desk viewing; fold it flat and it travels.

The Base of a Nine-Model Platform — AK16A is the entry configuration of an enclosure that also carries AQI display, app connectivity, upgraded sensors and a CO channel — one tooling, nine price points.

specs.Readings: CO2, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, HCHO, TVOC, temperature, humidity
